title: China Unveils 'World's First' Pilotable Flying Platform — But The US Had One In The '50s - BGR
summary: The Chinese aircraft design company CoolFly has unveiled a new pilotable flying platform known as Urban. CoolFly recommends using this flying platform for tourism, recreational outdoor activities, and even urban air mobility; a way to casually traverse the city.
